shortDescription: Manages zones on Apache CloudStack based clouds.

options.name: api_http_method
options.description: HTTP method used to query the API endpoint. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_METHOD) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_key
options.description: API key of the CloudStack API. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_KEY) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_secret
options.description: Secret key of the CloudStack API. If not set, the C(CLOUDSTACK_SECRET) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_timeout
options.description: HTTP timeout in seconds. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_TIMEOUT) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_url
options.description: URL of the CloudStack API e.g. https://cloud.example.com/client/api. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_ENDPOINT) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_verify_ssl_cert
options.description: Verify CA authority cert file. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_VERIFY) env variable is considered.

options.name: dhcp_provider
options.description: DHCP provider for the Zone.

options.name: dns1
options.description: First DNS for the zone. Required if I(state=present)

options.name: dns1_ipv6
options.description: First DNS for IPv6 for the zone.

options.name: dns2
options.description: Second DNS for the zone.

options.name: dns2_ipv6
options.description: Second DNS for IPv6 for the zone.

options.name: domain
options.description: Domain the zone is related to. Zone is a public zone if not set.

options.name: guest_cidr_address
options.description: Guest CIDR address for the zone.

options.name: id
options.description: uuid of the existing zone.

options.name: internal_dns1
options.description: First internal DNS for the zone. If not set I(dns1) will be used on I(state=present).

options.name: internal_dns2
options.description: Second internal DNS for the zone.

options.name: local_storage_enabled
options.description: Whether to enable local storage for the zone or not.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the zone.

options.name: network_domain
options.description: Network domain for the zone.

options.name: network_type
options.description: Network type of the zone.

options.name: securitygroups_enabled
options.description: Whether the zone is security group enabled or not.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the zone.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If V(false), SSL certificates will not be validated. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_DANGEROUS_NO_TLS_VERIFY) env variable is considered. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.
